title: Papa Joe's Pontoons
specs: Must be 18+ to rent and operate.
No experience is required to rent a pontoon boat.
Children under 16 do not need a license.
Our boats come with retractable Bimini tops, swim ladders, and all safety equipment.
Boats are easy to operate and no experience is required.

services.name: 12 Passenger Pontoon | 90 HP
services.desc: Pontoon boat rentals with a 90HP motor, Bimini top, life jackets and gas included for trips to Shell Island and around St. Andrews Bay.

services.desc: Pontoon boat rental for up to 12 passengers with a 60HP motor, Bimini top, life jackets, map and gas included for trips to Shell Island and St. Andrew

services.name: 8 Passenger Pontoon | 40 HP

gap: Cancellations will be accepted 24 hours prior to your tour departure. Reservations made on the same day as departure are non-refundable. No shows and those arriving too late for the tour will be charged the full amount. If we deem it necessary to cancel a tour due to inclement weather, we will refund or reschedule based on the customers request. There are no refunds once tours depart.
blurb: Just minutes from the Hathaway Bridge, our pontoons are ready to go from the docks at Papa Joe’s Bayside. It’s the perfect launch point for your bay adventure. Papa Joe’s Pontoons is proudly operated by Salty Pontoons, right here at Papa Joe’s Bayside on beautiful St. Andrews Bay. Same great location, same easy access to Shell Island, dolphin sightings, and stunning Gulf Coast waters. Browse available rentals below
